purpose: Separate internal structural readiness from teacher-facing publication readiness.

readiness_levels.internal_preview_ready: The card can assemble without inventing missing data and visibly carries evidence/pending labels.
readiness_levels.teacher_ready_with_caveats: Core curriculum comparison and teaching guidance are supported; unresolved details are explicitly labelled rather than inferred.
readiness_levels.exact_pep_grade_ready: Current PEP grade/semester placement is directly verified for the specific claim.
readiness_levels.research_pending: A core factual claim required for the requested view is not sufficiently verified.

current_pep_partial_volume_evidence: Grade 1 upper: selected current unit titles and sequence relationship

publication_policy: A concept can be internally previewed when exact PEP sequencing is pending, provided the China layer falls back to the verified national learning stage and labels the textbook placement pending.
Do not label a concept exact_PEP_grade_ready unless current edition, grade/semester and relevant unit placement are directly verified.
A curriculum-inferred misconception can be shown only as a possible misunderstanding/probe, not as a research-established misconception.
A direct empirical misconception source does not make the diagnostic question a validated test.
US mode must state Common Core baseline or a selected state; never render a generic nationwide US curriculum claim.

highest_priority_blockers.blocker: Current PEP Grade 1-6 exact semester/unit sequencing
highest_priority_blockers.impact: Prevents exact textbook-grade comparison for most Chinese grade selections.

highest_priority_blockers.blocker: China official 2022 PDF printed page locators
highest_priority_blockers.impact: Section locators work internally, but printed-page citation precision is incomplete.
